contributor to MP (1871-1893), principal of Lady Margaret Hall

Daughter of the Rt.

Rev.

Christopher Wordsworth, she was appointed Lady Principal of Lady Margaret Hall in 1878.

She contributed a poem to MP in 1871 under the name \'VERITAS\' and probably was the author of another 16 poems which appeared under that pseudonym to February 1883.

[Battiscombe, Reluctant Pioneer]
